novel_features.name: Caller-ID Guest Lookup
novel_features.description: Look up a guest by phone number or name and get every stay, payment status and reservation access PIN.
novel_features.rationale: Joins complete per-property reservation history with live payment and access details that no single API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this first when a guest calls or texts and you need to know who they are and which stay they mean.

novel_features.name: Guest Messaging Inbox
novel_features.description: Read recent guest messages and threads, and reply through the reservation thread with a dry-run guard.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps Hostfully's v3.3 messaging with a confirm-before-send reply path built for agents.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to triage new guest messages and draft or send replies without opening the web app.

novel_features.name: Live Complete Quote
novel_features.description: Price a stay for a property and dates with rent, taxes and fees itemized.
novel_features.rationale: Uses Hostfully's own quote calculation so totals match what the guest will be charged.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a prospective guest asks what a stay costs.

novel_features.name: Service Jobs
novel_features.description: List cleaning and maintenance jobs with service and provider identity, including cancelled jobs.
novel_features.rationale: Keeps cancelled jobs and provider names that invoice review needs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to reconcile a cleaning or service vendor's invoice against scheduled jobs.

novel_features.name: Multi-Unit Vacancy Finder
novel_features.description: Find consecutive vacant days across several units at once.
novel_features.rationale: Requires cross-unit date intersection over the local archive.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to plan work or owner stays that need several units free together.

novel_features.name: Maintenance Windows
novel_features.description: Find maintenance slots across units around upcoming bookings.
novel_features.rationale: Combines every unit's booking calendar into ranked free windows.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when scheduling repairs that must not disturb guests.

novel_features.name: Turnover Gap Detection
novel_features.description: See cleaning windows between each checkout and the next check-in.
novel_features.rationale: Requires ordered stays per unit from the archive.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to build the week's cleaning schedule.

novel_features.name: Occupancy Rate Analysis
novel_features.description: Per-unit and overall occupancy for any period.
novel_features.rationale: Computed from historical reservations in the local archive.

novel_features.name: Channel Mix Analytics
novel_features.description: Break down where bookings come from over a period.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to see which channels drive bookings.

novel_features.name: Revenue Estimation
novel_features.description: Estimate revenue per unit and month from booked nights.

novel_features.name: Booking Pattern Analysis
novel_features.description: Spot weekday/weekend and seasonal booking trends.
novel_features.rationale: Needs weeks of history from the archive.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for pricing and staffing decisions.

narrative.headline: Hostfully reservations and guest messaging — plus caller-ID lookup, quotes, and multi-unit vacancy analysis.
narrative.value_prop: Reads current operational data (today's guests, availability, caller identity, quotes) live from Hostfully, and keeps a local SQLite archive for historical analysis such as occupancy, turnover and vacancy windows. Unit numbers are discovered from your agency's properties, or pinned with HOSTFULLY_UNITS.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set HOSTFULLY_API_KEY to an agency API key and HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_ID to the agency UID; every Hostfully request is agency-scoped. Unit numbers used by today, availability, whois, quote, vacancy and the other per-unit commands come from HOSTFULLY_UNITS ("1=<property-uid>,2=<property-uid>"), a units.json file, synced properties, or live discovery of the agency's properties; run `hostfully-pp-cli units` to see the mapping. The property time zone comes from HOSTFULLY_TIMEZONE or the properties themselves. `inbox reply` is the one command that sends a guest message: it requires --yes and supports --dry-run.

quickstart.comment: Check configuration without touching the network
See how unit numbers map to your Hostfully properties
Check-ins, check-outs, in-house guests and vacant units
Identify a caller from their phone number

troubleshoots.fix: Set HOSTFULLY_API_KEY and HOSTFULLY_AGENCY_ID, then run hostfully-pp-cli doctor

troubleshoots.symptom: Unit numbers don't match your property names
troubleshoots.fix: Pin them with HOSTFULLY_UNITS="1=<property-uid>,2=<property-uid>" or a units map in the config file
Use hostfully-pp-cli fetch, which fetches per property and recovers failed pages through GraphQL

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for day-to-day Hostfully operations: identifying callers, checking today's arrivals and departures, live availability, quoting stays, reading and answering guest messages, and planning around vacancy. Use the archive-backed analytics for occupancy, turnover and channel questions. Channel analytics break bookings down by source such as Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO and direct. Reads are the default; `inbox reply` is the single command that sends a guest message, and it requires --yes (preview with --dry-run). Unit numbers map to properties via `hostfully-pp-cli units`.
anti_triggers: Changing rates, rules or listing content (use the Hostfully web app)
